title: Fourier expansion of coordinate expectation
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb N$, let $f:\{−1,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$, and choose $i\in\mathrm{Fin}(n)$ and $x\in\{−1,1\}^n$. The coordinate expectation of $f$ at $x$ is $\sum_{S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\},\ i\notin S}\widehat f(S)\chi_S(x)$, where $\widehat f(S)$ is the uniform-cube Fourier coefficient and $\chi_S(x)=\prod_{j\in S}x_j$.
